detail.summary: python -m pytest practice/tests failed on test_a_warning_extended_over_two_nights_is_revised_not_renotarized (1 of 153, both before and after this session's own changes -- confirmed pre-existing with git stash against main) -- the ci.yml workflow that gates this repository's own automerge runs this suite, so the failure was already blocking merges before this pass touched anything. Cause: the test hardcodes announced_at[:10] == "2026-08-22", but update_registry (practice/src/practice/foreknown/futures.py) stamps announced_at from utc_now(), the real wall clock, not from the `day` argument the test passes to run() -- correct in production, where day is always today, but a coincidence in the test, which only ever passed on the one real calendar date matching its hardcoded literal. Fixed by asserting the actual invariant the test's own name promises -- announced_at is unchanged between night one and night two -- captured from the registry after the first run() call rather than hardcoded, so the test no longer depends on which real day it runs.
